  cardMarketContent = '## Wakanda Forever: Chadwick Boseman''s Legacy

Black Panther: Wakanda Forever (2022) was both a tribute to Chadwick Boseman and an introduction to new characters. The film introduced Tenoch Huerta as Namor and Dominique Thorne as Riri Williams/Ironheart.

### Key Sets

The **2023 Upper Deck Black Panther: Wakanda Forever** set features Tenoch Huerta''s Namor debut, Dominique Thorne''s Ironheart debut, and Angela Bassett''s powerful Queen Ramonda.

### Market Trends

Chadwick Boseman memorial and tribute cards carry enormous emotional and collector value. Tenoch Huerta (Namor) debut autos are strong investments as Namor is a major Marvel character. Angela Bassett (Ramonda) cards gained value after her Oscar nomination for this role.',

- **Tenoch Huerta as Namor Debut Auto** — Major Marvel character ($2,500+)
- **Angela Bassett as Queen Ramonda Auto** — Oscar-nominated performance ($2,000+)
- **Dominique Thorne as Ironheart Debut Auto** — Future MCU star ($1,200+)
- **Letitia Wright as New Black Panther Auto** — Mantle passing ($1,500+)
- **Talokan/Atlantis Insert Set** — Underwater kingdom cards',
  content = '## Wakanda Forever

Wakanda Forever is one of the most emotionally powerful MCU films ever made. Ryan Coogler crafted a genuine tribute to Chadwick Boseman while telling a compelling story about grief, legacy, and the introduction of Namor and Talokan. Angela Bassett delivered an Oscar-nominated performance as Queen Ramonda, and Tenoch Huerta''s Namor is one of the MCU''s most complex antagonists.

## The Legacy

- **Chadwick Boseman Tribute** — The film honored Boseman''s legacy with grace and emotional depth
- **Namor** — Tenoch Huerta introduced the Sub-Mariner with a Mesoamerican reimagining
- **Ironheart** — Dominique Thorne debuted as Riri Williams, setting up her Disney+ series
- **Angela Bassett** — Earned an Oscar nomination for Best Supporting Actress as Queen Ramonda
- **Shuri as Black Panther** — Letitia Wright took on the mantle in an emotional transformation

## Fun Facts

- The film was completely rewritten after Chadwick Boseman''s passing in August 2020
- Angela Bassett''s Oscar nomination was the first acting nomination for an MCU performance
- Namor''s Talokan is based on Aztec/Mayan mythology rather than the comics'' Atlantis
- Rihanna recorded the original song ''Lift Me Up'' for the film''s soundtrack
- The underwater sequences required building massive water tanks and new filming technology

## Viewing Context

Wakanda Forever directly follows **Black Panther** (2018) and addresses T''Challa''s death (mirroring Chadwick Boseman''s real passing). It introduces Namor and Talokan, Ironheart (who gets her own Disney+ series), and sets up Shuri as the new Black Panther. The post-credits scene reveals T''Challa had a son.',

  faqData = '[{"question":"Is Wakanda Forever on Disney+?","answer":"Yes, Black Panther: Wakanda Forever (2022) is available on Disney+. The entire film is structured as a meditation on grief and legacy, honoring Boseman''s impact."},{"question":"What Wakanda Forever cards are valuable?","answer":"Chadwick Boseman tribute cards ($5,000+) carry enormous emotional value. Tenoch Huerta Namor debut autos ($2,500+) are strong investments. Angela Bassett autos ($2,000+) gained value after her Oscar nomination."},{"question":"Who is Namor in the MCU?","answer":"Namor (Tenoch Huerta) is the ruler of Talokan, an underwater civilization based on Mesoamerican mythology. The post-credits scene also reveals T''Challa had a son named Toussaint (T''Challa II)."}]',
